theorem.name: Licence-derived declaration is generated by the licensed steps
theorem.description: A licence-derived declaration is generated by exactly the licensed steps.

theorem.name: Classification-derived declaration is a licence-derived declaration
theorem.description: A classification-derived declaration is the licence-derived one for the licence the classification gives.

theorem.name: Signature equality characterization
theorem.description: Two signatures are equal exactly when every use gives the two records the same outcome.

theorem.name: Same treatment is an equivalence
theorem.description: Equal treatment is an equivalence relation.

theorem.name: Surface control yields same treatment
theorem.description: Surface control: records with equal mechanism values are treated the same.

theorem.name: Difference in treatment is carried by the mechanism
theorem.description: A difference in treatment is carried by a difference in mechanism value.

theorem.name: Record surface treats only equal records the same
theorem.description: The record surface treats two records the same exactly when they are equal.

theorem.name: Joint surface treatment characterization
theorem.description: A joint surface treats two records the same exactly when both surfaces do.

theorem.name: Faithfulness characterization by absence of a witness
theorem.description: Faithfulness holds exactly when no divergence witness exists.

theorem.name: Divergence witness separates mechanism values
theorem.description: Every divergence witness for a surface is a pair on which the mechanism's values differ.

theorem.name: Record surface faithfulness excludes any merge of distinct records
theorem.description: The record surface is faithful to a declaration exactly when the declaration relates no two distinct records. So without a registry constraint on mechanisms, every declaration that merges any two distinct records is divergent against some surface that Lean admits. That is why the audit's mechanism registry is a precondition of the method and not an optional refinement.

theorem.name: Faithfulness to a generated relation is checked on generators
theorem.description: When the treatment relation is an equivalence, faithfulness to a generated relation is checked on the generating pairs.

theorem.name: Faithfulness to a generated relation is consistency
theorem.description: Faithfulness to a generated relation is consistency of the generating pairs with the pairs asserted separated.

theorem.name: Surface faithfulness to a generated relation is consistency with its signature
theorem.description: A surface is faithful to the relation generated by `P` exactly when `P` is consistent with the pairs the surface's signature separates.

theorem.name: Faithfulness to a classification-derived declaration is presentation soundness
theorem.description: For the declaration a classification generates, faithfulness of a surface is soundness of its signature as a presentation.

theorem.name: Faithfulness to a licence-derived declaration is step-wise
theorem.description: A surface is faithful to the identity a licence generates exactly when it treats the endpoints of every licensed step the same.

theorem.name: Divergence is localized to one licensed step
theorem.description: If a surface is not faithful to the identity a licence generates, one licensed step accounts for it: the declaration licenses the step as a continuation, the surface treats its endpoints differently, and the mechanism's values differ there.

theorem.name: Faithfulness to generated identity is anti-monotone in the generators
theorem.description: More generating pairs make faithfulness harder: faithfulness to a larger generated relation gives faithfulness to a smaller one.

theorem.name: Store treatment is an equivalence
theorem.description: Store treatment is an equivalence relation.

theorem.name: Store faithfulness is faithfulness of every examined surface
theorem.description: Store-level faithfulness is faithfulness of every examined surface.

theorem.name: Store witness is a witness for some examined surface
theorem.description: A divergence witness for the store is a divergence witness for some examined surface.

theorem.name: Store faithfulness to a licence-derived declaration is step-wise
theorem.description: A store is faithful to the identity a licence generates exactly when every examined surface treats the endpoints of every licensed step the same.

theorem.name: Relation position is exhaustive and exclusive
theorem.description: Exactly one of four positions holds for two relations under containment.

theorem.name: Local position is exhaustive and exclusive
theorem.description: The four positions of `O` relative to `S` inside the declared classes are exhaustive and mutually exclusive.

theorem.name: Substitution implies local alignment
theorem.description: Substitution implies local alignment.

theorem.name: Substitution by an unfaithful alternative gives a divergence witness
theorem.description: If the alternative also fails to be faithful to the declaration, substitution gives a divergence witness: the treatment relation separates a declared pair.

theorem.name: Finite check characterizes faithfulness
theorem.description: On a complete enumeration, the check succeeds exactly when `O` is faithful to `D`.

theorem.name: Finite witness search characterizes faithfulness
theorem.description: On a complete enumeration, the search finds nothing exactly when `O` is faithful to `D`.

theorem.name: Pass characterization
theorem.description: A pass is exactly established assumptions together with faithfulness.

theorem.name: Fail characterization
theorem.description: A fail is exactly established assumptions together with a divergence witness.

theorem.name: Indeterminate characterization
theorem.description: An indeterminate verdict is exactly unestablished assumptions.

theorem.name: Unestablished assumptions never give a pass
theorem.description: Unestablished assumptions never give a pass.
